_readme: Edit this file to update country popup content. Values are from 261119 Request for Data NSTW 2026. Countries not covered by that document have empty jointResearch/jointScholarships arrays; existing map details remain available in index.html.

jointScholarships.details: Australia is one of the leading partners of DOST in scholarships. Almost 60 students were sent from 2020 to the present to universities including Queensland University of Technology, Griffith University, and Royal Melbourne Institute of Technology.

Under the ASEAN Cambodia, Lao, and Myanmar Scholarship Program, the Philippines hosts and funds CLM students at leading Philippine universities, including the University of the Philippines, De La Salle University, and Ateneo de Manila University. The first batch was received in 2017.
Scholarships are offered with partner universities including the University of Saskatchewan, the University of Alberta, and Dalhousie University. Scholars have been sent from 2020 to the present.

jointResearch.details: The partnership is with China's Ministry of Science and Technology. Projects began in 2022 and continue across several areas, with health as the leading area.
topAreas: Circular Economy, Renewable Energy, and Critical Materials
Agri-Aqua Technologies, Climate and Resilience Tech

jointScholarships.details: Scholarships with France have been ongoing since 2021. Students have been sent to leading universities including Sorbonne University, the University of Picardy Jules Verne, and Université Paris Sciences et Lettres.

jointResearch.details: The partnership is with India's Department of Science and Technology. Projects began in 2022 and cover several areas of cooperation.

jointScholarships.details: The partnership has been ongoing since 2021. Scholars attend the University of Trieste under the Fondazione Italiana Fegato (FIF) project.

jointResearch.details: Joint research is conducted through the JSPS Joint Scientific Research Program, the JST Water Security program, and the Philippines-Japan Call on Smart Agriculture under ASEAN NEXUS Funding. Projects began in 2018.

jointScholarships.details: The scholarship program has been ongoing since 2022, with students at Nagoya University, Osaka University, and Tokyo University of Marine Science and Technology.

jointResearch.details: Research engagement began in 2022 under the Philippines-Korea Joint Research Program. Renewable energy and circular economy are the leading areas.
topAreas: Agri-Aqua Technologies, Biopharma and Health Tech, AI

jointResearch.details: Taiwan is a long-standing research partner, with projects implemented from 2010 to the present under the MECO-TECO Joint Research Program, the MECO-TECO Volcano, Ocean, Typhoon, and Earthquake (VOTE) Initiative, and the MECO-TECO Health, Agriculture, and Training (HAT) Initiative.

jointScholarships.details: The Joint Scholarship is a sandwich program: scholars conduct research in Taiwan while completing other course requirements in the Philippines. Scholars have been sent since 2011 to universities including National Taiwan University, National Dong Hwa University, and National Tsing Hua University.
The joint scholarship program is with the Asian Institute of Technology. Students have been sent from 2025 to the present.

jointResearch.details: The research partnership with e-ASIA is under the e-ASIA Joint Research Program. Research under this program is usually conducted among three countries, rather than only two, to cover a wider area of impact. Projects have been implemented since 2013.

jointScholarships.details: Scholarships under the UK program ran from 2015 to 2019. Students were sent to the University of Glasgow, the University of Stirling, and the University of Edinburgh.
The joint scholarship program began in 2024. Students attend Michigan State University and Texas Tech University, mainly for agriculture-related study.
